selection_process: Selection for all 151 tenure-based ITI posts ispurely merit-based, combiningNCTVT/NCVT marks and Trade/Practical Test performance. || First, candidates areshortlisted for Trade/Practical Teston the basis of total marks obtained in the NCTVT/NCVT exam; the cut‑off percentage for calling candidates is decided by Ordnance Factory Kanpur. || ATrade/Practical Testis then conducted for the relevant trade (Machinist, Examiner, Electrician, etc.) at Ordnance Factory Kanpur to assess hands‑on skills. || Thefinal merit listis prepared using combined scores with80% weightage to NCTVT/NCVT exam marks and 20% weightage to the Trade/Practical Test. || Candidates placed in merit are called forDocument Verification, where all original certificates and eligibility conditions are checked; if some candidates are rejected at this stage, additional candidates in order of merit may be called until all notified posts are covered.
